cohort: The study included all deliveries (n=11,117) that occurred at Cantonal Hospital Zenica between 2020 and 2024.
finding: Fetal macrosomia constituted a substantial and relatively stable proportion (14.6%) of births at this referral center, with generally favorable immediate neonatal outcomes.
mod_finding: Primiparas with macrosomic births experienced a high cesarean rate (62.32%), though yearly changes in the overall mode of delivery distribution were not statistically significant.
birth_weight: All birth weights were included, with macrosomia defined as >=4,000 g and a mean macrosomic birth weight of 4,263.0 g.
